reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the pocket-size sachets that tear open with one hand, because I forget my bottle at home and live out of a tote, so a sachet in the bag fixes that. The QR lab report is a nice extra, but the price still stings next to my usual bottle, so I would try one box and see.
objection: $29.99 is about double what I paid for a bottle that lasts 3 months, so I am paying a lot for the packaging and I am not sure it is worth it every month.
